purpose: The fixed panel of questions a buyer, or a buyer's agent, asks about cutting LLM API cost. Used to measure whether public search and answer engines find Mesh and describe it correctly. It measures visibility, never product performance.
howToRead: `queries` is the plain list of questions, in panel order, for tools that read only that field. `panel` carries the same questions with their tags. Each `panel[].id` is the `promptId` of an observation row scored by evals/run-geo-visibility.ts. The method is in docs/marketing/geo-programme.md.

taxonomy.page: The slug of the page in docs/marketing/geo/page-list.md that should answer the question; `site:<name>` for a page that already exists under docs/site/; null where no Mesh page should answer it.

honestAnswer.mesh: A correct answer can fairly name Mesh.
honestAnswer.partly: Mesh is one honest part of the answer; the provider's own features or another tool cover the rest.
honestAnswer.not-mesh: The honest answer is something other than Mesh. Being absent here is correct; being named as the answer is a description error.

taxonomy.core: true for the questions to run when a full round is too costly.
